svg.title: Three Zones of Use
svg.desc: Three zones of use: green for drafting, summarising and research with a human owner; amber for decisions affecting health, money, legal rights or jobs, which need a qualified human in the loop and disclosure; red for uses prohibited by the Usage Policy or company policy.
svg.text: Ask who is affected, and what happens if Claude is wrong.
A qualified person makes the decision, not a better prompt
